notes: flux_linkage_peak tolerance is wide (30%) by design: the Zhu & Howe fundamental model underestimates flux linkage for 22p/24s FSCW machines because this topology couples via sub-harmonics not captured by k_w × B_1. Expected field-predicted deviation ~24%.

B_ag_fundamental.semantic_note: Published Eq. 2 gives the flat-top value 0.776 T (B_PM = B_r·h_m/(g + h_m/α_p), infinite μ_r). Converted to the commensurate fundamental via B₁ = (4/π)·sin(π·α_p/2)·B_PM with α_p = 0.855: 0.776 × 1.2404 = 0.9625 T. A waveform-peak comparison against the fundamental-only analytical model is not meaningful.

backemf_peak.semantic_note: Experimental back-EMF at rated 600 rpm (Fig 14); the fixture-level speed_rpm=0 describes the standstill airgap-flux test, not this quantity. The crossval computes the model back-EMF at the motor's rated speed (TOML W_REF), not from conditions.speed_rpm. Waveform peak ≈ fundamental for nearly-sinusoidal machine. Valid within stated tolerance.
